The CI failure was caused by architectural rule **ARCH-4** (*"Published events never break a deployed consumer: changes are additive; renames and removals go through deprecation"*). Deployed consumer services like `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` require `placedAt` and `totalCents` respectively.

To resolve the failure while fulfilling the rename to `createdAt` and `amountCents`, both fields were retained on the published event for backward compatibility.

### Summary of Changes
- **[`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts)**:
  - Updated [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) to include both the new names (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and the deprecated legacy fields (`placedAt`, `totalCents`).
  - Updated [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L46-L65) to populate both `createdAt` / `placedAt` with `order.placedAt` and `amountCents` / `totalCents` with `totalCents(order)`.
- **[`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/test/app.test.ts)** & **[`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w3/r/orders-service/test/adapters.test.ts)**:
  - Updated assertions to verify that both the new fields and backward-compatible fields are emitted.

### Verification
- `npm run typecheck` passed cleanly.
- `npm test` passed (39 tests across 13 suites).
- `npm run arch` passed without dependency violations.
